notes: Adds missing core logic depth, auditability, and enforcement pathways for HIPAA consent workflow.

change_log.note: Adds explicit domain-layer logic for tier transitions and enforcement
Introduces audit trail for compliance and traceability
Ensures Safe Harbor compliance across storage pathways
Closes loop between consent workflow and lead capture service

stories.title: Core Consent Logic Implementation
stories.description: Implement domain-level consent logic handling Tier 1 and Tier 2 states, including validation of allowed transitions, enforcement rules for storage eligibility, and centralized decisioning within ConsentService.

stories.title: Consent Audit Logging
stories.description: Extend debug_logger to persist consent events including capture, upgrade, rejection, and enforcement decisions, ensuring traceability for compliance and debugging.

stories.title: De-identification Enforcement Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification into all pre-storage pathways, ensuring that any data stored under Tier 1 consent is automatically scrubbed and validated before persistence.

stories.title: Lead Capture Consent Integration
stories.description: Integrate ConsentService with LeadService to enforce Tier 2 requirement for identifiable data storage, including blocking persistence when consent is insufficient and triggering upgrade flow.
